race.comment: TAG ALONG (6) looks close to another win after finishing third last time (23.81) at Horsham. One of the leading chances. STOJANOVIC (2) found the going tougher but ran well to place over 400m at this track (22.75) in Grade 4/5. Won an easier race the start before that at Shepparton. Has a good record here at this journey. Form from his last run is proving strong. Winning chance. OUT OF ELITE (3) was in the money last start and poses a threat again. Something for the Multiples: MAGIC MANIA (8)
